validate: too long for one fact: Under the Wireless Content License Agreement between Fox and Glu Mobile, the rights granted to Licensee are specifically limited to Wireless Products for the Wireless Platform and do not extend to any other device, platform, operating system or distribution method, including traditional entertainment software console platforms (such as Sony PlayStation, PlayStation 2, Microsoft Xbox, and Nintendo GameCube and successors), desktop or laptop computer systems (such as PC Windows and Macintosh), hand-held dedicated gaming devices (such as Nintendo's GameBoy Color and GameBoy Advance, Sony's PSX handheld device, and Tiger Electronic hand-held devices), pay-per-play arcade systems and other location-based entertainment, interactive toys, television (via cable, satellite, set-top boxes or on-demand service), massively multiplayer games, internet gaming, and any other technology now known or hereafter devised.

Under the Wireless Content License Agreement between Fox and Glu Mobile, "Intellectual Property Rights" is defined to include know-how, inventions, patents, patent rights, registrations and applications with renewals, continuations and extensions, works of authorship and art, copyrightable materials and copyrights (including titles, computer code, designs, themes, objects, characters, character names, stories, dialog, catch phrases, concepts, artwork, animation, sounds, musical compositions, graphics, visual elements, audio-visual effects, methods of operation, and related documentation), copyright registrations and applications with renewals and extensions, mask works, industrial rights, trademarks, service marks, trade names, logos, trademark registrations and applications with renewals and extensions, trade secrets, rights in trade dress and packaging, publicity, personality and privacy rights, moral rights, and all other forms of intellectual property and proprietary rights recognized by U.S. laws and other applicable foreign and international laws, treaties and conventions.

Under the Wireless Content License Agreement between Fox and Glu Mobile, Licensee agrees to indemnify, defend and hold harmless Fox, Trademark Licensor and their respective successors, assigns, parents, subsidiaries, affiliates and co-venturers, and their respective directors, officers, employees and agents from all third party claims, damages, losses, liabilities, suits and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees) arising out of allegations that the Licensee Materials or the manufacture, packaging, distribution, promotion, sale, or exploitation thereof (except with respect to matters against which Fox has agreed to indemnify Licensee) infringes or misappropriates the Intellectual Property Rights of any third party, provided that Fox promptly notifies Licensee in writing of the claim, grants Licensee sole control of the defense subject to Fox's approval of counsel to avoid conflicts of interest and of the terms of any settlement that affect Fox, and provides Licensee at Licensee's expense with all assistance, information and authority reasonably required for the defense and settlement of the claim.

Under the Amendment No. 3 to the Cisco and ScanSource Distributor Agreement between Cisco Systems, Inc. and ScanSource, Inc., the Distributor (ScanSource, Inc.) will not use money or other consideration paid by Cisco, or its own money on Cisco's behalf, for unlawful purposes, including direct or indirect payments to government officials (including persons holding executive, legislative, judicial or administrative offices, whether elected or appointed, or of any public international organization such as the United Nations or World Bank, or persons acting in an official capacity for such government, public enterprise or state-owned business), political parties or party officials, candidates for political office, or any person known to be offering, giving or promising such money or value directly or indirectly to those persons or organizations, for the purpose of assisting Cisco in obtaining or retaining business.

decision_floors.grounded: Under the Wireless Content License Agreement between Fox and Sorrent, Inc., Fox and Vodafone Group Services Limited (VGSL) have entered into a wireless content distribution agreement (the VGSL Agreement) whereby Fox is to be the content provider for VGSL wireless products relating to various Properties, and Fox desires a license to distribute Wireless Products to VGSL pursuant to the VGSL Agreement.

Under the Wireless Content License Agreement between Fox and Sorrent, Inc., Fox grants Sorrent, Inc. (Licensee) a limited, exclusive (except as otherwise provided in the agreement), non-transferable (except as permitted in Paragraph 17(d)) right and license to use, make, have made (as set forth in Paragraph 1(a)(i)), reproduce, modify, and create derivative works of the PSM in each Property, solely for the purpose of developing the wireless applications specifically set forth for each of the Properties on Exhibits B through M (the Wireless Products), some of which are defined in the Glossary attached as Exhibit N.

Under the Wireless Content License Agreement between Fox and Glu Mobile, Glu Mobile expressly acknowledges and agrees that Fox has entered into the VGSL Agreement with VGSL for the development of certain Wireless Products set forth on Exhibits B, C, D and G, in connection with the Properties "Robots," Untitled Ridley Scott Film, "Ice Age 2," and "Mr & Mrs. Smith."

Under the Wireless Content License Agreement between Fox and Glu Mobile (Licensee), Fox will remit all VGSL Revenue to Licensee and such VGSL Revenue shall be treated as Gross Receipts for the purpose of the Wireless Content License Agreement.

Under the Wireless Content License Agreement between Fox and Glu Mobile, copies of notices to Fox are to be sent to its Legal Department (facsimile (310) 369-4241) and its Finance Department (facsimile (310) 369-8531) at Twentieth Century Fox Licensing & Merchandising, P.O. Box 900, Beverly Hills, California 90213, and 2121 Avenue of the Stars, Los Angeles, California 90067.
